why_we_love_it_excerpt: Welcome to Off Piste Cottage, a stunning coastal retreat professionally curated and managed by Stay on 30A. Perfectly located in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach and less than 600 yards from door to the public beach access. This thoughtfully designed four-bedroom home was created with both comfort and connection in mind, making it ideal for family vacations, group getaways, or friends traveling together. From the moment you step inside, the home welcomes you with effortless coastal sophistication. The layout flows naturally from one gathering space to the next, perfect for slow mornings with coffee, relaxed afternoons between beach trips, and easy evenings spent reconnecting after a day along 30A. The fully stocked kitchen is designed to make group stays effortless. Whether you're preparing a quick breakfast before the beach or cooking a full dinner for the group, you’ll find everything you need to feel right at home. It’s a space built not just for cooking, but for gathering where conversations continue long after the plates are cleared. Each bedroom offers its own calm and comfortable space, giving everyone room to unwind, and the home features private balconies perfect for stepping outside with a morning coffee, catching a coastal breeze, or enjoying quiet moments before the day begins. Just across the street, you’ll find the community pool, making it incredibly easy to cool off, lounge in the sun, or take a refreshing dip whenever the mood strikes. Exploring the area is just as effortless. Your stay includes six adult bikes, making it easy to cruise through Blue Mountain Beach, reach nearby beach access points, and explore neighboring 30A communities at your own pace. And if your group is looking for a little extra flexibility, there’s a golf cart rental shop just down the street, making it simple to add a cart during your stay. Known for its laid-back atmosphere, scenic beauty, and proximity to local favorites, Blue Mountain Beach offers a more relaxed side of 30A perfect for guests who want to slow down without sacrificing access to the best dining, beaches, and coastal experiences the area has to offer. At Off Piste Cottage, thoughtful design, modern comfort, and coastal charm come together to create the perfect setting for meaningful moments, shared experiences, and unforgettable memories along 30A.

HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -6 Adult Bikes -Public Beach Access is a Short Walk From The Home -Espresso Machine + Keurig + Drip Coffee  -Private Balconies -Outdoor Shower -Community Pool Steps From the Home -Gas Fire Pit -Gas Grill -Full Size Washer and Dryer -Beach Gear ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps: 12   FIRST FLOOR: -Bedroom #1: King With Ensuite -Bedroom #2: Queen -Bedroom #3: Queen -Hall Bathroom SECOND FLOOR: -Living Room -Kitchen- Dining Room -Hall Bathroom -Sleeper Sofa THIRD FLOOR: -Bedroom #4: (2) Twin/Twin Bunks  **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | Pool Towels WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | Coffee Filters | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING: Two driveway parking spaces available. Included are 6 adult bicycles for your convenience.  BEACH ACCESS Three public beach accesses a short distance from the home: 1. Gulfview Heights Access is just a short walk from the home. It has parking, restrooms, showers, picnic tables with shelter, and lifeguards during peak season. Located less than 600 yards from the home. Turn by Goatfeathers Seafood restaurant at Gulfview Heights street. 2. Shellseekers Beach Access is a simple walkover at the end of Shellseekers Cove about one block south of Scenic 30A and a few blocks east of the Scenic 393 intersection at Gulf Place. It may be the most well hidden access in SoWal. 3. Spooky Lane Beach Access is at the entrance to Seahaunts Condominiums where Spooky Lane meets the Gulf. From the intersection of Scenic 393 at Gulf Place and Scenic 30A, travel east about 1/4 mile then south on Spooky Lane. There is parking for bikes only. BLUE MOUNTAIN COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTS: -Blue Mountain is a laid-back coastal gem celebrated for its natural beauty, relaxed pace, and small-town charm. As the highest elevation along Scenic Highway 30A, it offers scenic dune views, peaceful beaches, and some of the most stunning sunsets on the Gulf. The area is dotted with beloved local spots, from homemade ice cream at Blue Mountain Beach Creamery to casual bites at Red Fish Taco and slow-smoked favorites from Blue Mabel Smokehouse. Locally owned shops, bike paths, and friendly gathering places add to the community feel, making Blue Mountain the perfect escape for those seeking an authentic, unhurried 30A experience. -Just a short bike ride away is Gulf Place. A beach neighborhood where inspiration waits around every corner. Whether you’re a beach bum, foodie, shopper, or art lover, you’ll find your passion here. From live music venues to innovative art spaces, there’s a whole world to explore. Start your morning off right with a latte and sweet treat from Sunrise Coffee Co. After a walk along the shore or a quick dip in the gulf, grab a refreshingly cold local beer at Growler Garage. From Alabama ales to Florida sours, this local favorite brings brews to the beach. When it’s time to head to dinner, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar’s fresh gulf seafood and views are unparalleled. And don’t forget to save room for dessert! Satisfy your sweet tooth with a Southern praline or waffle cone from Pecan Jack’s Ice Cream & Candy. Cava & Cakes and Shelby’s Beach Bar & Grill offer additional (and picture-perfect) sweet and savory favorites to round out your dining experience. Activities for every interest abound in Gulf Place. Unwind with a reflexology massage or enzyme facial at Awakening Wellness Organic Spa. Explore the palm tree-lined streets and neighborhood shops at Gulf Place Town Center. Ultimately, the best part of beach life is kicking off your shoes and feeling the sand between your toes. For sunset strolls and inspiring views, drift down to the Ed Walline Regional Beach Access. With ample parking, restrooms, bike racks and proximity to lifeguards in season, it couldn’t be more welcoming. -Flying in from out of town instead of driving? Flying into ECP (Panama Beach City) airport is a 50 minute drive to the house. Flying into VPS (Destin airport) is a 40 minute drive. HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  *Must remain pet free *During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues, no wifi, or slow wifi. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".
